title: Flag day scoped to Linus's tree; core set from pullers
description: Rescope the flag day: pgpkeys freezes globally; on the flag day only Linus's tree and release tags stop accepting GPG (gpg.openpgp.program=false); core set = git-vouch-migrate pullers over Linus's mergetags; every other tree switches by the late cutoff, which ends GPG for tags and patches alike. DESIGN, rationale, runbook, guides, rehearsal.
